'''2000 Swedish National Championship Sealed Deck''' was a Star Wars CCG sealed deck held in Lund, Sweden on 9 April 2000. It is known from Martin Akesson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d504">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-11-swedish-championshipsd504/ swedish-championships], DeckTech (Martin "Mart" Akesson, 11 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-11-swedish-championshipsd504/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[2000 Swedish National Championship]].

* '''Date:''' 9 April 2000
* '''Site:''' Lund, Sweden
* '''Format:''' [[Sealed Deck]]
